Revalidation letters can be found at https://msc.fema.gov by using Search All products, selecting your community, and accessing the “Effective Products” and “LOMC” folders.

All LOMA revalidation statuses are for informational purposes only. For more information on how this revalidation status was determined, please contact your local community official.
